full_description: Travel Planner is a comprehensive trip planning app designed to help users organize their travels with ease. It allows users to create personalized itineraries, book flights, and find suitable accommodations. With Travel Planner, you can research destinations, add activities, and make reservations all in one place. The app also provides features such as real-time flight updates, accommodation reviews, and destination guides to ensure a seamless travel experience. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway or a long-awaited vacation, Travel Planner is the perfect tool to help you make the most of your trip.
